text:
The builder is likely to recover **$14,000**: his $10,000 in sunk costs plus $5,000 expected profit, less the $1,000 he got from reselling the materials. The $3,000 increase in property value doesn't reduce the award, because the homeowner was the party in breach. Courts that measure recovery differently could land near $15,000 or $10,000, so the figure is not certain.

CONFIDENCE: 70
